::: {.home-intro-text}
Hi! I'm Hyunchang Kweon, and I also go by Thomas. I'm currently studying aerospace engineering at Seoul National University and have been admitted to Purdue University for a master's degree in aerospace engineering. My interests include safe control and data-driven learning for aerial platforms.
:::
:::

## Featured work

[**Occlusion-Aware Drone Tracking**](projects/occlusion-drone.qmd) — Model predictive control for tracking a moving target while avoiding obstacles and preserving line of sight.

[**Autonomous Rescue VTOL Aircraft**](projects/robot-aircraft-competition.qmd) — Visual target recognition and alignment control for the 23rd Korea Robotic Aircraft Competition. Our team placed in the top 7 of 37 teams.

[**2025 AIAA Design/Build/Fly**](projects/aiaa-dbf-2025.qmd) — CFD team leadership, airfoil selection, aerodynamic analysis, and fluid–structure interaction analysis for Team Korea's competition aircraft.

[**Motion Blur in Aerial 3D Reconstruction**](projects/cs592-aerial-reconstruction.qmd) — FFT-based analysis of motion blur in drone imagery and its effect on 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstruction quality.
